title: "[Verification] "
labels: []

---

## Type of report

- [ ] Mathematical proof issue
- [ ] Computational certificate issue
- [ ] Independent reproduction succeeded
- [ ] Documentation or citation issue
- [ ] Other

## Location

File, theorem/lemma/equation, line, interval row, or program involved:

## Summary

Describe the finding precisely.

## Evidence or reproduction

Provide a counterexample, derivation, exact commands, environment details, and
relevant output.

## Effect on the claimed result

Explain whether this appears to affect the main claimed values, a bridge
interval, the infinite-tail theorem, or only presentation.

## Independent implementation

State whether your check was an independent implementation or a direct run of
the supplied code.
